_comment: Trigger-scintillator DAQ map for the ESA slice test (Detectors/data/ldmx-reduced-v3).
Maps each decoded ZCCM pad collection (produced by runZCCMDecode.py) to a
TrigScintGeometry module index. The ZCCM decoder has already applied the
(moduleMap_4modules_14lanes.txt) maps, so digis arrive bar-addressed by
chanID; this map only fixes the remaining decode-module -> geometry-module
(cabling) correspondence, analogous to the tracker map's (feb,hybrid) ->
decode_pad N == moduleMap module (N-1); lanes are the moduleMap lane group.
geo_module is the index into TrigScintGeometry.module_z (reduced-v3:
pad1=-381.0, pad2=-305.8, pad3=-76.2 mm). ASSUMPTION: decode Pad1/2/3 ==
geometry pad1/2/3 -- edit geo_module here (not the geometry) if the cabling
differs. The LYSO pad (Pad4, 12 bars) is not yet in TrigScintGeometry, so
geo_module=-1 marks it as not-yet-mapped (skipped by the producer).
